name: Akai MPC2000XL
description: Sampling workstation and MIDI sequencer with 16 performance pads.

documentation.title: Akai MPC2000XL: manufacturer or original documentation

notice: Choose the input/output MIDI ports and track channels on the MPC. Pad note assignments depend on the loaded program; use MIDI learn instead of assuming General MIDI drums. No fixed pad map, mixer automation or transport mapping is provided. For computer use, connect MIDI OUT to interface MIDI IN; connect interface MIDI OUT to hardware MIDI IN when controlling the instrument. Port names are intentionally empty: interface or app names do not reliably identify the attached hardware. Select this profile manually. This is partial coverage, not a complete MIDI implementation. The panel is an original schematic; virtual keyboard note numbers are illustrative and require MIDI learn or octave adjustment.
